<thought>The 13C NMR shows two distinct signals in the aromatic region (≈143.9 ppm and 130.3 ppm). This pattern is typical for a symmetric aromatic ring such as a para‑disubstituted benzene, which contains six aromatic carbons overall, even though only two unique carbon environments are observed. Therefore, the molecule has six aromatic carbons.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
